# Rule catalogue

Every rule `dpa-review` runs, generated from the rules in [`src/dpa_review/checks.py`](../src/dpa_review/checks.py). A finding is open when its status is `MISSING` or `NEEDS_REVIEW`. Any open `HIGH` finding makes the packet `BLOCKED` (exit `2`); any other open finding makes it `NEEDS_REVIEW` (exit `1`); otherwise it is `CLEARED_FOR_REVIEW` (exit `0`), which still needs a lawyer's sign-off. Input keys are described in [input-format.md](input-format.md).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Transfer rules by basis

`transfer.<country>` checks each direct destination and `transfer.subprocessor.<name>` each sub-processor outside the EEA. In the rule id, `<name>` is the sub-processor's name in lower case (Unicode case folding), with each run of characters other than letters and digits replaced by one underscore: "Support Tools, LLC" gives `transfer.subprocessor.support_tools_llc`. Both rules use the same assessment of the country and the recorded mechanism (status and severity):

| Destination | `none` | `adequacy` | `sccs` | `bcr` | `dpf` | `derogation_art49` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EEA member state (e.g. DE) | PRESENT (INFO) | PRESENT (INFO) | PRESENT (INFO) | PRESENT (INFO) | PRESENT (INFO) | PRESENT (INFO) |
| Adequacy country (e.g. JP) | PRESENT (LOW) | PRESENT (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (MEDIUM) |
| Other third country (e.g. US) | MISSING (HIGH) | MISSING (HIGH) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (LOW) | NEEDS_REVIEW (MEDIUM) |

## Reference data

The country lists the transfer rules use, as they stand in `checks.py`. They are illustrative and carry no as-of date yet: verify them against the European Commission's current [adequacy decisions](https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/adequacy-decisions_en) before relying on a result.

- EEA (30): AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, ES, FI, FR, GR, HR, HU, IE, IS, IT, LI, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, NO, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK
- Adequacy (Art. 45) (14): AD, AR, CA, CH, FO, GB, GG, IL, IM, JE, JP, KR, NZ, UY
